articles.title: Child safety groups urge Amazon and eBay to stop selling AI toys until proved safe
articles.summary: Advocates from across the world voice concern over privacy issues and inappropriate communication to children. More than 150 child safety groups and experts across six continents have urged Amazon and eBay to stop selling AI toys this Christmas until they are proved to be safe.
body: In a letter sent to Amazon’s president, Andy Jassy, and eBay’s president, Jamie Iannone, the coalition called for the online retailers to stop the sale of AI toys and offer refunds to customers who have already bought one.
The coalition, which includes the psychologist Jonathan Haidt’s The Anxious Generation Movement and UK and US child safety groups, says the risks associated with these toys are “well documented”.
The listing was pulled by Amazon, but after 48 hours the toy returned to the platform under a new retailer, according to Alliance 4 Children. The second listing has now been removed by Amazon.
“These toys are cheap, easy to buy and largely untested,” the letter stated, also noting that they were marketed towards children as young as three years old.
points: Advocates from across the world voice concern over privacy issues and inappropriate communication to children.

articles.title: How freaked out should we be? After mass outages, experts tell us how close we are to ‘doomsday’
articles.summary: As tech, travel and banking failures sweep the US, analysts and cyber-security directors discuss AI, underfunding and what keeps them up at night. Grounded flights. Bank websites crashing. Microsoft Outlook outages grinding business operations to a halt. Zoom, Ikea, and PokerStars websites hacked.
body: Even those who aren’t prone to conspiracy theories have been wondering out loud if these recent disruptions are somehow connected. Speculation runs wild about targeted cyber-attacks by Iranian hackers, or AI agents autonomously hacking critical (air traffic, banking) and not-so-critical (the Ikea website) infrastructure.

For their part, politicians and the spokespeople of affected companies have denied such master plots. And while many presumed that the nationwide airline ground stoppage on 13 November resulted from the Federal Aviation Administration’s rollout of new AI-assisted administration software (called, perhaps aspirationally, the Smart System), the FAA themselves laid the blame on a downed router in Arkansas. Microsoft has chalked the recent outage to Outlook not to malicious intrusions, but some buggy code that has been laying dormant for months. Some people will buy such explanations. Others, naturally, may remain skeptical.
Just how worried should we be? Are these disruptions just a new, extremely annoying part of daily life?
points: As tech, travel and banking failures sweep the US, analysts and cyber-security directors discuss AI, underfunding and what keeps them up at night.

body: Few jewelry pieces have quite the staying power of a good hoop earring. It’s one of the most essential pieces in one’s jewelry collection, complements almost any outfit, and never goes out of style. Whether you prefer gold, silver, huggies or jumbo hoops, this classic go-to style holds the power to pull together any look. Its appeal lies in the versatility—there’s an appropriate version for every occasion. Pair a simple gold Jennifer Fisher Samira hoop with a white button-down and jeans to polish off your everyday uniform, or add sparkly pavés to your evening look to make a statement.

Jewelry designer Jennifer Fisher, hoop aficionado, has said it’s the one jewelry piece her clients rely on most when wanting to feel more polished. She’s played a part in accessorizing some of society’s most influential, from Jennifer Lopez to former first lady Michelle Obama in her coveted hoop earrings. articles.title: Charred Cabbage With Yogurt and Hot Sauce
articles.summary: If you think cabbage is boring, this dish will absolutely change your mind. Charred aggressively, it takes on a smoky, almost meaty quality—it’s the main event.
body: In a blender, combine 9 pickled Fresnos, stems removed and roughly chopped, plus 2 Tbsp. brine, 1 small shallot, roughly chopped, 3 garlic cloves, 3 Tbsp. red wine vinegar, juice of 1 navel orange, and 1 tsp. kosher salt. Blend on high, taking a pause to scrape the sides, until smooth. With the blender running on low, slowly pour in 1 cup extra-virgin olive oil until the sauce is silky and runny. Transfer the sauce to a bottle or jar and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks.
Preheat the oven to 425°F and set racks in the center and top of the oven. Line a sheet tray with parchment paper.

Make the Cabbage: Cut 1 large head green cabbage in half, then slice each half into four wedges. Arrange on the prepared sheet tray, drizzle generously with extra-virgin olive oil and kosher salt, and massage it into all those craggy layers. Roast on the center rack for 20–25 minutes, until a knife slides through easily. Set the broiler to high and slide the cabbage to the top rack. Broil for 2–4 minutes, until the edges are deeply charred and irresistibly crispy.

articles.title: Traveling This Thanksgiving? Here’s the Latest on Flight Delays Following Delta Outage
articles.summary: Delta Air Lines delayed hundreds of flights on Sunday due to an issue with its weight and balance system, which was restored later that afternoon. Here's what travelers need to know.
body: On Sunday, November 22, US travelers faced another wave of significant flight disruptions ahead of Thanksgiving.

This time around, the issues occurred at the nation’s busiest hub, Atlanta’s Hartsfield-Jackson International Airport (ATL), where Delta Air Lines delayed hundreds of flights due to a problem with a critical piece of technology.

The delays sent ripple effects throughout the carrier's US network, snarling travel plans for thousands of Delta fliers heading out on Thanksgiving trips. While the issue was resolved Sunday afternoon, the airline delayed 300 flights and canceled 92 flights on Monday morning, according to FlightAware. “Operations are stable today with automation for departing flight weight and balance calculations fully restored,” a Delta spokesperson told Traveler on Monday. “Delta teams are focused on keeping the operation moving safely and caring for our customers.”

articles.title: 27 Luxurious (and Truly Over-the-Top) Beauty and Wellness Gifts
articles.summary: No budget was considered in the making of this list, which has something for the protein-maxxer, the sleep detoxer, and the barefoot bohemian in your life.
body: Some people are fans of practical gifts. Others want an experience, like a beach getaway or ski trip. One of my favorite gifts to receive? The ability to be a voyeur into your holiday season.

I live for social media posts of ornament-laden trees sparkling over piles of color-coordinated packages or perfectly curated table settings. Ditto Instagram stories featuring people unwrapping presents with nary a care for their delicate camellia bows or designer ribbons. (“Save them!” I silently scream, proving my grandmother is still with me in spirit.) Every time a holiday rolls around, I’m waiting to see what the Kardashians will get up to—matching golf carts for all the kids on Christmas? Hermès china, ultimately returned? A suite of identical puppies? Show me now.

In the off season (aka January to October), I fantasize about what will be next—what are the greatest gifts to give if there were no budget restrictions? Once, I was told there was “no budget” when it came to a shopping experience (and if the person who uttered the phrase to me unwisely assumed I would be at least sensible, no dice)—I applied the same mantra to these beauty and wellness items in this story.
